hero.subTitle: Trusted by Nature
hero.description: From bulk export to fully custom private label manufacturing, we deliver premium, tested and certified products and ingredients — the way global food and wellness brands need them.

categories.title: What We Offer
categories.editableSeedsDesc: Faar Earth is a trusted edible seeds supplier and exporter from India, offering premium basil seeds, flaxseeds, pumpkin seeds and melon seeds for the global nutrition, bakery and health-food industry. Every batch is sourced and quality-tested to meet international food-safety standards, making us a preferred edible seeds manufacturer for brands that demand consistency at export scale.
categories.coldPressedOilsDesc: As a leading cold pressed oils supplier from India, Faar Earth delivers unrefined, nutrient-rich oils including moringa oil, castor oil, jojoba oil, hemp seed oil, almond oil, sesame oil, black seed oil and virgin coconut oil. Our cold pressed oil is supplied to cosmetic, wellness and food-processing partners worldwide, with private label and bulk packaging options available.
categories.whiteLabellingDesc: Faar Earth is a full-scale private label manufacturer in India, helping health, nutrition and food brands launch their own product lines without the complexity of building a manufacturing setup from scratch. From custom formulation to white label packaging, we act as your OEM manufacturing partner from raw material sourcing to export-ready finished goods.

products.title: A Glimpse of Our Range
products.description1: We are sourcing the best of seeds, spices, nuts, oils, botanicals, naturally derived food additives, plant-based protein powders, plant extracts, and freeze dried fruits and vegetables — pairing this with a decade of experience in the packaging industry to give our clients the product they want, the way they want it, including private label and white-label solutions.
products.description2: As a business, we constantly strive to not only keep up with the latest developments in health and food industries, but also work with our partners to develop products that can create better end-products and make a meaningful impact.
products.description3: We do not just chase transactions; we build supply chains. We actively seek long-term, contractual partnerships with global food processors to ensure a consistent, predictable, and price-stable supply of raw materials, mitigating the risks of global market volatility.
products.pumpkinSeedsDesc: Hulled, sun-dried pumpkin seeds packed with natural oils and minerals.
products.sunflowerSeedsDesc: Premium grade sunflower seeds, cleaned and graded for bulk supply.
products.flaxSeedsDesc: Golden and brown flax seeds rich in omega-3 and dietary fibre.
products.chiaSeedsDesc: Farm-fresh chia seeds sourced responsibly for everyday nutrition.
products.blackSesameDesc: Traditionally cleaned black sesame with a deep, nutty aroma.
products.oliveOilDesc: Slow, cold-pressed olive oil that retains natural flavour and nutrients.
products.mustardOilDesc: Traditionally extracted mustard oil with a bold, pungent character.
products.coconutOilDesc: Virgin coconut oil extracted fresh, preserving natural sweetness.
products.dietaryFibreDesc: Fine-milled dietary fibre sourced from natural plant husks, ideal for functional food and nutraceutical formulations.
products.pulsesDesc: Sun-dried, sorted pulses and lentils supplied in bulk with consistent quality and moisture control.
products.sweetenersDesc: Naturally derived sweeteners processed and packed to meet global food industry standards.

about.title: Rooted In Nature
about.subTitle: Committed to Quality
about.description1: At Faar Earth, we strive to provide the best of ingredients to food processing industries globally. We are a premier, India-based export enterprise specialising in sourcing, processing and delivery of high-quality agricultural ingredients and plant-based solutions.
about.description2: We bridge the gap between India's rich agricultural biodiversity and stringent global quality standards. Headed by two people combining very complimentary skillsets of a seasoned corporate veteran and someone who grew up in an Indian family business, we offer seamless, reliable and highly scalable supply chain solutions designed for modern food manufacturers.

howToOrder.step3Desc: Agree quantity, price (FOB/CIF as required), and lead time.
howToOrder.step4Desc: COA, Certificate of Origin, and any requested testing/phytosanitary certification issued ahead of dispatch.
howToOrder.step5Desc: Order processed within the stated category lead time.

section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.p1: This Cookie Policy explains how Faar Earth Collective ("we," "us," "our") uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on www.faarearth.com (the "Site"). It explains what these technologies are, why we use them, and your rights to control our use of them.
section1.p2: A separate Privacy Policy covering how we handle personal data more broadly is in preparation and will be linked here once published. In the meantime, any privacy questions can be directed to us using the details in Section 11.

section2.title: 2. What Are Cookies?
section2.p1: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to recognise your device and remember information about your visit, such as your preferences and actions on the site.

section3.title: 3. How We Use Cookies
section3.intro: We use cookies for the following purposes:
section3.sub1Desc: These cookies are essential for the Site to function properly. They do not require consent, as they are strictly necessary to provide the service you request.
section3.table1Purpose: Keeps an authorised staff member signed in to the content-management area. Not set for ordinary visitors.
section3.sub2Desc: These cookies allow the Site to remember choices you make to provide enhanced, more personal features.
section3.table2Purpose: Remembers your selected site language across visits.
section3.sub3Desc: These cookies help us understand how visitors reach and use the Site and measure the performance of our advertising.
section3.table3Name: Set by Google (e.g. _gcl_au and related identifiers)
section3.table3Purpose: Measures the effectiveness of our advertising and conversion tracking.
section3.table3Duration: Per Google's published retention periods (typically up to 90 days)
section3.sub4Desc: We do not currently run marketing or retargeting pixels such as the LinkedIn Insight Tag or Meta Pixel on this Site. The Instagram and LinkedIn icons in our header link out to those platforms but do not themselves set cookies on this Site. This section will be updated if that changes.

section4.title: 4. Your Consent Choices
section4.intro: When you first visit the Site, a cookie banner lets you:
section4.li1: — consent to all cookie categories (Functional, Analytics, Marketing)
section4.li3: — choose consent individually per category (Functional / Analytics / Marketing)
section4.p1: Non-essential cookies (Functional, Analytics, Marketing) are not set until you provide consent, and choosing "Reject All" — or unchecking a category in "Manage Preferences" — removes any of our own non-essential cookies already set (for example, the language cookie described in Section 3.2). Strictly necessary cookies (Section 3.1) are set regardless, as the Site cannot function without them.
section4.p2Pre: You can change your choice at any time via the
section4.p2Suffix: link in the site footer, which reopens this preference panel.

section5.li2: : we rely on your consent for non-essential cookies, in line with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD).

section6.title: 6. Third-Party Cookies
section6.p1: Some cookies are placed by third-party services that appear on our Site. We do not control these cookies. Please refer to the third party's own policy for further information:
section6.p2: Where Analytics cookies are enabled, this may involve transferring some data to Google LLC in the United States. Google maintains its own safeguards for such international transfers; see the link above for details.

section7.title: 7. How to Control Cookies via Your Browser
section7.p1: In addition to the consent banner on this Site, most web browsers allow you to control or delete cookies through their settings. Disabling cookies may affect how well this and other websites work.

section8.title: 8. Data Retention
section8.p1: Cookie data is retained only for as long as necessary for the purpose it was collected, as set out in Section 3. Your consent choice itself is stored only in your own browser (not on our servers), so it lasts until you clear your browser's stored data for this Site or change your choice via "Cookie Settings," at which point you will be asked again.

section9.title: 9. Your Rights
section9.p1: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details in Section 11.

section10.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
section10.p1: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised.
